# NovoTech Machine Tools Inc.

> Metalworking and metal fabrication machinery supplier in Mississauga, Ontario, Canada. Sells, installs and supports press brakes, laser cutters, shears, ironworkers, plate rollers, angle rolls, bandsaws, cold saws, rebar benders and cutters, pipe benders, hydraulic presses, bevelers, deburring and finishing machines, notchers and press brake tooling. Machines are supplied with CSA-approved electrical panels and supported with spare parts and technical support from Canada.

Contact: +1 647 526 5510 · info (at) NovoTechMachineTools.com · 1365 Mid-Way Blvd, Unit 26, Mississauga, ON L5T 2J5, Canada.
NovoTech is appointing independent sales agents and dealers in cities and provinces across Canada; enquiries through the quote form on any product page or by phone.
Social: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@NovoTechMachineTools · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/novotech-machine-tools-inc/ · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/novotechmachinetoolscanada · Instagram https://www.instagram.com/novotech_machinetools/
Brands represented include GMS GöçMakSan (rebar machinery), Dener (press brakes, shears, lasers), İşitan, Şahinler, Bekamak, Pilous, Gecam, CKEMSA, LFSS, Hidroliksan, Cevisa and EUROSTAMP tooling.

## Product pages

- [Rebar benders and rebar cutters (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bender-and-cutter): every GMS rebar machine NovoTech supplies, with a single-bar capacity table for the whole range.
- [Rebar benders](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-bending-machines): stationary B and BS series benders (Ø1″–Ø2-3/8″ / 26–60 mm), portable MG and BT benders on 110/220 V, SL stirrup benders, SX and AXIS 50S spiral benders, dowel bar benders, the MAX 40 combined bender-cutter and HB/MH mesh machines — specification tables in inches and millimetres, photos and videos.
- [Rebar cutters](https://novotechmachinetools.com/rebar-cutter): hydraulic H series (H 26–H 55), mechanical M series (M 36–M 55), double-acting SH 45 and SH 60, and the portable POWER 24 — cutting capacities for one or two bars at 45/65/85 kg/mm² steel.
- [Automatic rebar processing lines](https://novotechmachinetools.com/automatic-rebar-processing-lines): SLS 12 CNC stirrup bender from coil, MATRIX 55 / 55S shear lines, SYNCLONE 45S servo double bender — technical specifications, capacities and videos.
- [Metal cutting band saws (overview)](https://novotechmachinetools.com/band-saw): horizontal band saws in two lines — premium Bekamak (Turkey) and NovoTech's own value line (NT series) — with a capacity table for each line, a band saw buying guide (sizes, pivot vs double column, blades, speeds and feeds, troubleshooting) and FAQs.
- [Bekamak manual band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-manual-band-saws): BMS 230DG / 270DG gravity-feed double-miter saws, Ø9″–10-5/8″.
- [Bekamak semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-semi-automatic-band-saws): BMSY DG/DGH double-miter, 320G/GL single-miter and straight-cut saws, Ø9″–17-3/8″ (230–440 mm).
- [Bekamak automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-automatic-band-saws): BMSO roller-feed, E encoder-feed, 350GA, GS servo and 270DGS NC saws.
- [Bekamak double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/bekamak-double-column-band-saws): BMSY C / CGH / DG NC, BMSO C / CS / CGS / XS and heavy-duty saws from Ø13″ to 59″ (330–1500 mm).
- [NovoTech value line manual band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-manual-band-saws): NT-M 10 series (10″, mitre vise / swivel bow / hydraulic down-feed / twin-mitre) and NT-M 16 (15-3/4″) — value line.
- [NovoTech value line semi-automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-semi-automatic-band-saws): NT-H 10 S, NT-H 10 T, NT-H 13 / 13 C, NT-H 16, NT-H 12 SC single-column, NT-H 18 — hydraulic saws Ø10″–18″.
- [NovoTech value line automatic band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-automatic-band-saws): NT-A 12 / 12 T roller-feed, NT-A 12 SC single-column, NT-A 13 twin-mitre with 20 ft stand, NT-A 14 / 16 / 18 / 24 CNC servo saws.
- [NovoTech value line double-column band saws](https://novotechmachinetools.com/novotech-double-column-band-saws): NT-DC 11 / 11 T / 11 A / 11 AV, NT-DC 14 / 16 and NT-DC 20 / 24 gantry saws, Ø11″–23-5/8″.
